name: harness_prompt
description: Drives one prompt through a Hermes governance test harness over /api/ws and returns the transcript.

parameters.name: PROMPT
parameters.description: The prompt to send to the harness agent

parameters.name: TIMEOUT_SECONDS
parameters.description: Give up if the turn has not completed in this long

parameters.name: RESUME_SESSION
parameters.description: Existing harness session id to continue; blank starts a new one
